exposure: levator ani muscle function and integrity (LAM avulsion, LAM damage, levator hiatal area)
outcome: urinary incontinence (stress incontinence, urge incontinence, any incontinence)
cohort: A cohort of 92 patients from the Obstetrics and Gynecology department at Al-Zahraa University hospital.
finding: There is a correlation between levator ani avulsion and a greater probability of postpartum urine stress incontinence, but an insignificant correlation between the Kristeller technique and any urinary incontinence.
mod_finding: There is an insignificant correlation between the Kristeller technique (a birth intervention) and the occurrence of any urinary incontinence.
